title: Give fl_forager's dividing, food-eating gliders an r-two56-style set-point shell channel, then starve one daughter: does that reach IBED (C:metabolic-cell) in the Lenia family?
summary: c18's lenia loop found that in plain multichannel Lenia the bounded shelled bodies (r-two56 cogs) are robust non-growing fixed points (0/48 single-kernel perturbations divide), and every growing state is an unbounded front (lcn worms, rings) broken only by collisions (20261025T1518, 20261025T1621). Cogs on a closed food-waste ledger depend on food (local cut kills them in ~50 t, 4/4 seeds; 20261025T1559), but do not divide; MIRd+ divides but is planted, glides and has no clear shell. Flow-Lenia's fl_forager already divides on an exact matter+food ledger (L6[L2]+L4b). The missing pieces there are a boundary layer and a per-individual starvation fork. r-two56's shell mechanism is portable: a second channel S that grows where the ring-sensed core density hits a set point (kernel k4) and decays elsewhere forms a band at a fixed distance from the core, and removing k4 lets S spill into a domain-filling labyrinth (20261025T1559 controls).
experiment: Fork threads/flow-lenia/worlds/fl_forager. Add a non-flowing (or flowing) shell channel S with Lenia growth dS/dt = G(K4 * A_core; m, s) - k_S S, using r-two56's k4 ring (b 7/12,5/12,12/12, r 0.861, m 0.2344, s 0.0616) rescaled to fl_forager's kernel radius; S costs food like matter (keep the ledger exact) and does not feed back at first. Scan m in {0.18, 0.23, 0.28} x k_S in {0.05, 0.2} on 1 seed (6 runs of ~4 min at 128^2) and keep the setting where S forms a band around each glider (radial: S peak outside the A core, S/core-centre and S/outside >= 2). Then run 3 seeds (labkit pack) and, at a division, starve one daughter with a moving food-cut mask (re-centred on the daughter's A centroid every step, r = 1.5 body radii; the sister and a fed twin from the same state keep their food). Controls: k4 ablation (S contrast gone), and fl_forager without S (does S change division?). Pass: S band on >=80% of gliders, persistent splits >=2 generations, and the starved daughter dies while sister and twin persist on >=2 seeds.
